chains.claim_quote: Contribution Statement[82] • Physical Pipeline: We developed an end-to-end pipeline that translates an intent-to-convey message into an LLM output, which is then converted into a Raspberry Pi command to control the physical eHMI system. • Field Study: We conducted a field study evaluating the communicational effectiveness of LLM-generated eHMI actions with real participants. • Comparison Analysis: We provide a comparative analysis of eHMI actions designed by humans versus those generated by LLMs, highlighting differences in their underlying logic of action planning.
